## Purpose
The process knowledge package. It holds business-process documents that ground agent and workflow design.

## Responsibilities
The docstring maps the modules:
- `templates`: the JSON Schemas that documents follow;
- `validation`: the one checker;
- `store`: documents, versions and usage;
- `resolver`: which documents a build uses;
- `context`: per-layer views of those documents;
- `pipeline`: the contract layers call, a no-op when the feature is off;
- `ai`: fix or draft a document, never saving it.

Processes are concepts in the catalog's `process` scheme, linked to their domains.
